terrain.headline: Short gamma — trend regime. Follow breaks, do not fade.

implied_1d_move.method: S x sigma_ATM x sqrt(1/252), one standard deviation (68.3pct); sigma = mean ATM call/put implied vol of the first expiry at least a day out

lines: Dealers are modelled net short gamma (from OI, not observed positioning): they buy strength and sell weakness, amplifying every move.
Spot 757.08 vs flip 761.22 (+0.55%) — 0.55% below the regime line.
At the lower edge — wait for the reaction at the put wall, do not anticipate.
Trade with a break of put wall 760.00 (+0.39%) or call wall 775.00 (+2.37%); fading here gets run over.

COMPOSITE.source_text: Schwab NYSE_BOOK + NASDAQ_BOOK · composite, newest quote of each exchange

detail.weights: Headline weights by price level from the touch: 0.43, 0.26, 0.16, 0.10, 0.06 (exp(-0.5·(k-1)), normalized; renormalized over the levels a thin side has). Starting weights from a vendor study (VisualHFT, touch-weighted), adjustable.
detail.zones: Zones, a provisional guide and not a research finding: BALANCED under 10% (Bookmap's colour-switch line); BID or OFFER HEAVY from 10% to under 70%; VERY ONE-SIDED from 70% (a VisualHFT vendor study, not a peer-reviewed paper). The middle range grades direction only, not strength. The headline is the median of the last 5 seconds; a zone changes after 3 seconds across its line; a flip is a change of side, bid to offer or back, held that long; 5 or more flips in 2 minutes read CHOPPY.
detail.construction: Composite: every exchange's and market maker's quote from the books Schwab sends for this symbol, one per contributor by side; where a contributor quotes in both books (Nasdaq's NSDQ, for SPY and IWM), the copy with the newer quote time Schwab sent; then the shares summed at each distinct price and the best five prices per side. With one book, the composite is that book. Never the two books' level totals summed.
detail.spans: Top 5 covers different price ranges on the two venues — the percentages are over different prices, so compare directions, not magnitudes. The touch is the only like-for-like comparison across venues.
detail.books: NYSE_BOOK is each exchange's best quote grouped by price, not order depth. NASDAQ_BOOK carries Nasdaq's own quote and market makers' quotes.
